# Chinese Fortune Calendar

> > Comprehensive Chinese astrology resource featuring Bazi (八字) fortune-telling, lunar calendars, zodiac predictions by Master Tsai, baby gender charts, and Feng Shui guidance rooted in Five Elements (五行) and I-Ching philosophy.

Chinese Fortune Calendar provides traditional Chinese metaphysical knowledge including annual zodiac forecasts, lunar calendar conversions, baby gender prediction studies with statistical analysis, and detailed explanations of Bazi (Eight Characters), Ten Gods system, Yin Yang philosophy, and Taoist principles for fortune-telling and life guidance.

## Key Topics

- Bazi (八字) - Eight Characters fortune-telling system
- Five Elements (五行) - Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water
- Chinese Zodiac - 12 animal signs and yearly predictions
- Master Tsai - Chinese astrology expert and fortune-teller
- Chinese Lunar Calendar - Traditional calendar system
- Baby Gender Prediction Chart - Conception planning tool
- Day Master - Core element in Bazi analysis
- Feng Shui - Chinese geomancy and spatial harmony
- I-Ching (易經) - Book of Changes divination
- Yin Yang - Fundamental duality principle
- Ten Gods System - Bazi relationship analysis
- Stem-Branch System - Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches
- Chinese New Year - Lunar New Year traditions and celebrations
- Taoism - Philosophical foundation of Chinese metaphysics
- Zodiac Compatibility - Relationship harmony analysis
